name: Valuables
description: Portable wealth, trade goods, status objects, and collectibles

fields.description: Local currency mixing common small coins with harder-to-spend foreign money.
An identifiable piece of jewelry, portable but risky to resell.
A painting, sculpture, or decoration with recognizable cultural value.
A robe, cloak, boots, or gloves associated with a rank or institution.
A symbol of authority missing a gem, inscription, or essential piece.
A personal item decorated with a discreet crest or intimate inscription.
One piece of a sought-after series, trivial alone but valuable to the right person.
A cut or rough stone whose value depends on quality and local demand.
Old coins valued more by collectors than their face value.
A small matched set marked with an identifiable pattern or crest.
A compact bolt of fine cloth suitable for trade or ceremonial clothing.
A portable work whose maker, subject, or material gives it value.
A complete and collectible volume sought by specialists.
Ornaments associated with rank, office, or a formal tradition.
Compact merchandise whose resale value varies between settlements.
